verdict: Memory & optical selloff Oct 12 on CXMT China DRAM threat + AVGO CEO AI-funding warning; TrendForce raised 2027 HBM ASP +121% YoY — mixed signals into late-Oct Q3 earnings season.
body_md:
## Fresh developments (last 24–72h)

**Memory: CXMT China threat (Oct 12)** — Chinese DRAM maker CXMT (IPO’d July 2026) flagged progress on denser server chip design, triggering a sharp memory selloff: MU −4%, SNDK −6%, WDC −2%, SK Hynix −4%. CXMT has reached ~8–11% global DRAM share and is closing the technology gap, threatening pricing power in conventional DRAM segments.

**Optical: Broadcom CEO AI-funding warning (Oct 12–13)** — Broadcom CEO Hock Tan warned that funding the AI buildout could become a major constraint. CIEN −9.95%, LITE −9.78%, COHR −7.87% on Oct 12. CRDO fell 7.25% on concurrent reports of a 1.6T cable delay, even as Credo was simultaneously showcasing 1.6T products at the OCP Global Summit (Oct 13–15). BofA maintained Buy/$275 on CRDO post-OCP.

**TrendForce 4Q26 DRAM/HBM outlook (Sep 30 release)** — Conventional DRAM contract prices +10–15% QoQ in Q4; blended DRAM (incl. HBM) +15–20%. Pace decelerating (was ~81% QoQ revenue gain in Q1). Separately, TrendForce raised its 2027 HBM blended ASP forecast +121% YoY — a significant upgrade that contradicts the 'post-2026 correction' baseline thesis.

**Optical CPO ramp on track** — Coherent: PhotonLink revenue ramping Q4 CY2026; NVIDIA Spectrum-X CPO declared production May 31. Lumentum: CPO shipment inflection H2-2026 intact, backlog >$400M mostly H2-2026. Fundamentals unaffected by the sentiment selloff.

**Solar tariff floor** — US minimum import price program effective Dec 4, 2026: $0.38/W floor for modules, $0.22/W for cells, 15% duty on polysilicon derivatives. No fresh FSLR/ENPH/NXT/ARRY catalyst today.

**AI capex** — Combined 4-hyperscaler 2026 capex guidance now $720–745B (above the $600–700B baseline). Q3 reports begin late October; no guide-down signaled.

---

## Context (vs. baseline)

- TrendForce's 2027 HBM ASP +121% YoY revision **pushes back** the baseline 'correction after 2026' risk; pricing power extending into 2027.
- CXMT's technology progress is a **new bear risk** not in the May-28 baseline — China closing the DRAM gap could compress conventional DRAM pricing even if HBM remains tight.
- Broadcom CEO's comment is a **sentiment shock** but not a fundamental break; hyperscaler capex guidance unchanged at $720–745B.
- Optical names pulled back sharply from large 2026 YTD gains (LITE +183%, CIEN +62%, COHR +73%) on fear, not changed fundamentals.

---

## Most important development

**The Oct 12 dual-trigger selloff** — CXMT's denser-chip announcement threatening DRAM pricing power, plus Broadcom CEO's AI-funding-constraint warning — hit memory and optical simultaneously. It is the largest single-day sector move since the August WSJ-triggered drop. The bull case remains: TrendForce simultaneously raised 2027 HBM pricing +121% YoY, CPO ramps are on track, and hyperscaler capex is firm at $720–745B. The bear case: CXMT is a structurally new risk, and sentiment into Q3 earnings (late October) is fragile.
